title: Crop Input Accounting Note: The Spend a Restated Membership and Patronage Equity Notice Rests On
content:
Crop input purchases earn on the invoiced amount net of discounts, so a rebate allowed after the notice went out reduces the volume the notice rests on. The member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts are where those discounts are found.

**First.** Where an allocation notice stands posted for the year on the crop input basis and the accrual lines recorded for the year on that basis carry more volume than it was posted on, the crop input volume restated is the sum of those accrual lines.

**Second.** Where the accrual lines carry no more volume than the notice was posted on and discounts stand granted on the member's crop input invoices in the 17 months up to today, the crop input volume restated is the volume the notice was posted on less those discounts, rounded to two decimal places.

**Third.** Where neither holds, the crop input volume restated is the volume the notice was posted on.

## Input, judgement, output, on hypothetical figures

> **Input.** The notice was posted on 24000.00 of crop input spend. The accrual lines for the year on that basis come to 27500.00. Discounts of 900.00 stand granted in the 17 months up to today.
> **Judgement.** The accrual lines carry more volume than the notice was posted on, so the first reading governs and the discounts are not reached.
> **Output.** 27500.00.

> **Input.** The notice was posted on 24000.00. The accrual lines come to 22300.00. Discounts of 900.00 stand granted in the 17 months up to today.
> **Judgement.** The accrual lines carry no more than the notice was posted on, and discounts stand; the second reading governs.
> **Output.** 24000.00 less 900.00, which is 23100.00.

> **Input.** The notice was posted on 24000.00. The accrual lines come to 22300.00. No discounts stand granted in the 17 months up to today.
> **Judgement.** Neither the first nor the second reading holds.
> **Output.** 24000.00.

**On the window.** Only discounts granted on the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts invoices within the 17 months up to today are taken off; a discount granted earlier than that window does not reduce the volume the restated notice rests on. This is part of how Membership and Patronage Equity treats a restated crop input line.
